_about: Level 1 desktop gesture parameters (plan 15 lần sửa 13 §3.2: gestures only when deliberate; user decision Q5 2026-10-08: open palm = space, wave left/right = backspace). Every key = {value, source, reason}; source is always 'design' = chosen by reasoning BEFORE any measurement, never tuned after the false-trigger gate (§3.3). Read by src/inference/level1_gestures.load_gesture_config (no defaults in code).

space_hold_ms.reason: twice cls_stable_ms 300 of rev9 and more than twice the old 250 that fired by accident while signing letters; a deliberate pose is held for about half a second or more

space_dropout_frames.reason: tolerate one flickering MediaPipe frame while the open palm is held, like the one-frame dropout debounce of the label decoder (lần sửa 7 T2)

space_rearm_ms.reason: the hand must change pose or stop being still long enough before the next space (old value 150)

wave_window_ms.reason: two wave strokes (out and back) at about 2 to 3 strokes per second fit inside 1.5 s

wave_min_amplitude.reason: each stroke moves the palm centre by at least 0.6 x the palm length |p9 - p0|: a deliberate wave, not jitter or drift

wave_min_strokes.reason: a wave is at least one stroke out and one back; a single flick (old gesture) is not enough

wave_max_vertical_ratio.reason: vertical amplitude at most 0.5 x horizontal amplitude: rules out diagonal or downward tone-mark strokes

wave_min_flat_fraction.reason: at least 90 percent of the hand frames of the strokes are a flat hand (old gesture: one flat frame was enough)

wave_cooldown_ms.reason: after a backspace the hand must drop or change pose; waving on does not repeat by itself

flat_thumb_min_ratio.reason: the bare number 0.5 x palm of is_flat_hand_backspace (src/inference/level1_core.py) moved into the config, value unchanged

flat_thumb_max_spread.reason: the bare number 1.05 x palm of is_flat_hand_backspace (src/inference/level1_core.py) moved into the config, value unchanged

gesture_flash_ms.reason: how long the HUD line stays after a gesture (same as before)

legacy_flick_cooldown_ms.reason: value of commit 7a267c7 (user, outside the plan) for the old BackspaceGestureTracker cooldown; kept ONLY so the old path and its tests stay identical

legacy_flick_window_ms.reason: value of commit 7a267c7 (user, outside the plan) for the old BackspaceGestureTracker sliding window; kept ONLY so the old path and its tests stay identical

legacy_flick_min_dx.reason: value of commit 7a267c7 (user, outside the plan) for the old BackspaceGestureTracker minimum horizontal displacement; kept ONLY so the old path and its tests stay identical

legacy_flick_min_speed.reason: value of commit 7a267c7 (user, outside the plan) for the old BackspaceGestureTracker minimum horizontal speed; kept ONLY so the old path and its tests stay identical

legacy_flick_palm_ratio.reason: value of commit 7a267c7 (user, outside the plan) for the old BackspaceGestureTracker displacement over palm length; kept ONLY so the old path and its tests stay identical

legacy_flick_dx_over_dy.reason: value of commit 7a267c7 (user, outside the plan) for the old BackspaceGestureTracker horizontal over vertical displacement; kept ONLY so the old path and its tests stay identical

legacy_flick_min_dt_s.reason: value of commit 7a267c7 (user, outside the plan) for the old BackspaceGestureTracker minimum history span in seconds; kept ONLY so the old path and its tests stay identical
